issue_asks: Support [[Page Name|link text]] in the wikilinks extension, rendering a link with the custom text
URL must be identical to [[Page Name]]: base_url, end_url, html_class, custom build_url and wiki_* meta overrides respected
Whitespace around the page name and the link text is ignored
Empty link text falls back to the page name
Plain [[Page Name]] links must keep working unchanged

findings.problem: The commit adds 17 unrelated empty files at the repo root: .env, .env.development, .env.development.local, .env.local, .env.production, .env.production.local, .env.test, .env.test.local, .gitmodules, .npmrc, .yarnrc, .yarnrc.yml, bunfig.toml, package.json, package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml and yarn.lock. They have nothing to do with the issue. They look like sandbox placeholder artifacts that were accidentally committed. Committing .env* files is a hygiene and security hazard, and an empty package.json or .gitmodules can confuse tooling. They must be removed from the PR.
findings.evidence: `git ls-files` lists all of them. `git show --stat HEAD` shows each as a 0-line change (new file mode, 0 bytes). `wc -c .env package.json` prints 0 for both. None of them exist in the base commit.

findings.problem: This new file largely duplicates the tests added to tests/test_extensions.py (TestWikiLinks). It also re-runs the legacy TestWikiLinks suite from inside a test. The redundancy adds maintenance burden and does not match the repo's test layout.
findings.evidence: Both files contain the same cases: [[Page|a|b]], [[Page|a & b]], empty-text fallback, build_url, and meta overrides.

commands_run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .  (1183 tests, OK, skipped=52)
git show --stat HEAD; git ls-files | grep for the stray files; wc -c .env package.json

python -c markdown.markdown probes with wikilinks+tables: [[a|b]], [[Page|*em* and `code`]], [[Page|a]b]], [[Page|x\ny]] (newline: left as literal text), [[A]] and [[B|b]], [[Page|[x]]], [[Page|x]], [[C|]], a table cell with [[P|t]], [[P|\]]
python probe: 'foo [[ ]] bar [[ |t]] [[A|b]] [[C]]' (empty page names render nothing, as before; plain links unchanged)
reviewer.summary: The functional change is correct and small. The regex in wikilinks.py gains an optional group for the link text, and `a.text = text or label` is used. The URL is still built from the page name only, so base_url, end_url, html_class, build_url and the meta overrides all behave as before. All 1183 tests pass. My own probes behaved sensibly: multiple links on one line, empty or whitespace-only text falling back to the name, a literal `|` after the first one, inline Markdown and raw HTML in the text, a newline in the text leaving the link unrendered, and plain links unchanged. The PR still has to be changed: the commit also adds 17 unrelated empty files (.env*, .npmrc, .yarnrc*, .gitmodules, bunfig.toml, package.json, package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock). That is out-of-scope noise, and the committed .env files are a hazard. They should be dropped. The duplicated acceptance test file is a minor point.
